snippet.title: Goo Deer Is Finally Here - (A Weird Gas Station Survival Horror Game)
snippet.description:
Welcome to a dark first-person gas station management horror game where the world is addicted to Goo Deer. Craft new flavors, sell product, manage your store, hunt deer for ingredients, and survive whatever is waiting in the fog.

Play / Wishlist Goo Deer on Steam:
store.steampowered.com/app/4349210/Goo_Deer/
